top_signals.summary: The Nvidia CEO admitted to having an affair with a woman who could have been a Chinese spy.

top_signals.title: AZ-VC's Selby on Why Anthropic's IPO Puzzles Him
top_signals.summary:
AZ-VC Founder & Managing Partner Jack Selby questions why Anthropic is rushing into the public markets when, in his words, the company has 'so much cash on their balance sheet, almost as much as Google'.
He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)
